title: NPS Maintenance Records & D.C. DOH "Bailout" of Neglected Federal Pond (Square 5815)

communications.subject: Freedom of Information Act Request: NPS Maintenance Records & D.C. DOH "Bailout" of Neglected Federal Pond (Square 5815)
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

TO: ncr_foia@nps.gov
CC: ncr_superintendent@nps.gov, nro_info@nps.gov, erin.roberts@dc.gov, carl.filler@dc.gov, ayanna.bennett@dc.gov, doh.foia@dc.gov, ldonovan@wusa9.com, chernande1@wusa9.com, sabrooks@wusa9.com, tkopania@wusa9.com

SUBJECT: FOIA Request: NPS Maintenance Records & D.C. DOH "Bailout" of Neglected Federal Pond (Square 5815)

To the NPS FOIA Officer:

Under the federal Freedom of Information Act (5 U.S.C. § 552), I am requesting access to public records regarding the federally owned parcel designated by the District of Columbia as Square 5815, Lot 0802. This National Park Service property is located adjacent to 2200 1/2 Hunter Place SE and the Morris Road SE pedestrian corridor in Washington, D.C.

Please provide copies of the following records, dating from January 1, 2015, to the date this request is processed:

1. Maintenance & Hazard Records: All hazard assessments, environmental inspections, maintenance logs, and vector control records conducted by or for the National Park Service regarding this specific parcel.
2. Inter-Agency Communications: All communications (including emails, memorandums, letters, citations, and meeting minutes) sent between the National Park Service and any agency of the District of Columbia government—specifically including the Department of Buildings (DOB), Department of Energy and Environment (DOEE), Department of Transportation (DDOT), Department of Health (DOH), and the Mayor's Office—regarding stormwater runoff, geotechnical slope failure, erosion, or mosquito/vector abatement on this parcel.
3. D.C. Health Interventions & Bailouts: Any permits, authorizations, notifications, or communications regarding the D.C. Department of Health (DOH) entering this federal property to conduct vector (mosquito) abatement due to the severe lack of federal maintenance.

Fee Waiver Request:
I am requesting a fee waiver because the disclosure of the requested information is in the public interest and will contribute significantly to public understanding of government operations. This request is being made in my capacity as a Ward 8 Community Advocate and ANC Candidate to uncover severe environmental and life-safety hazards—specifically an active 25-foot landslide and a toxic vector basin—currently threatening a residential pedestrian corridor. This request is strictly non-commercial. If fees are assessed, please notify me before proceeding.

I request that these records be provided in a digital format.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter.

Sincerely,

Fred Gamble Jr.
Ward 8 Community Advocate
District 8A04
Fort Stanton Neighbors
1490 Morris Rd SE
Washington, DC 20020
(301) 651-8904

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

FRED GAMBLE JR
